lines.zh: 我的甲壳刮着洞壁，一路响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the cave wall and rings all the way.

lines.zh: 六条腿一起动，声音像碎石滚。
lines.en: Six legs move together, sounding like rolling gravel.

lines.zh: 深层没有光，我靠震动走。
lines.en: The deep has no light; I walk by vibration.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头爬到那块石头。
lines.en: I crawl from this rock onto that one.

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，总是碰到洞顶。
lines.en: My legs are so long they keep hitting the ceiling.

lines.zh: 石头缝里全是我的爪痕。
lines.en: The cracks in the stone are full of my claw marks.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，甲壳几乎不响。
lines.en: I keep low and my shell barely makes a sound.

lines.zh: 前面塌方了，我绕过去。
lines.en: The tunnel ahead caved in, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，甲太重了。
lines.en: I walk slowly; the shell is too heavy.

lines.zh: 洞顶在滴水，我避开那一片。
lines.en: The ceiling drips, and I avoid that patch.

lines.zh: 我踩过的石头都会松一层。
lines.en: Every stone I step on sheds a layer.

lines.zh: 我顺着石壁往上爬，不用爪钩。
lines.en: I climb the rock face without any hooks.

lines.zh: 深层的空气很闷，我闻得到你。
lines.en: The deep air is stale, and I can smell you.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，等石头稳住。
lines.en: I stop at each step, waiting for the stone to settle.

lines.zh: 我卡在石缝里，扭两下才出来。
lines.en: I wedge in a crack and twist twice to get free.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞到钟乳石，碎了一小块。
lines.en: My shell strikes a stalactite and chips.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，和它一个颜色。
lines.en: I lie on the stone, sharing its exact color.

lines.zh: 我把腿收进壳下，慢慢磨牙。
lines.en: I tuck my legs under the shell and grind my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 洞里有回音，我听了很久。
lines.en: There is an echo in the cave and I listen a while.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳上长了小石头。
lines.en: Small stones have grown on my shell.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像一块碎石。
lines.en: When I do not move, I look like broken rubble.

lines.zh: 我在等洞顶的水滴到我身上。
lines.en: I wait for a drop from the ceiling to reach me.

lines.zh: 腿这么多，闲着也不知道放哪。
lines.en: With so many legs, I do not know where to put them.

lines.zh: 我数自己的腿，总是一样多。
lines.en: I count my legs and they are always the same.

lines.zh: 这一带的石头我都爬过了。
lines.en: I have crawled over every stone in this area.

lines.zh: 深层岩缝里没人听得见我。
lines.en: No one hears me in the deep rock cracks.

lines.zh: 洞底有块暖石，我挤过去。
lines.en: There is a warm stone on the floor and I squeeze onto it.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨壳，掉下一层粉。
lines.en: I rub my shell and a layer of powder falls.

lines.zh: 你举着灯，我第一次看清石头。
lines.en: You hold up a lamp, and I see the stone clearly for once.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到我，我的壳反光。
lines.en: Your lamp finds me and my shell throws back light.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛只在光里存在。
lines.en: I raise my head; my eyes exist only in the light.

lines.zh: 你站在塌方口，挡住了我的路。
lines.en: You stand at the cave-in and block my path.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，判断你离我几步。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging how many steps away you are.

lines.zh: 你别踩那层松石，会塌。
lines.en: Do not step on that loose layer; it will give.

lines.zh: 你的靴底比石头软，我听得出。
lines.en: Your soles are softer than stone; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里看你，只露半边甲。
lines.en: I watch from the crack, showing only half my shell.

lines.zh: 你身上有种不属于深层的气味。
lines.en: You carry a smell that does not belong in the deep.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的灯，不是因为怕。
lines.en: I stare at your lamp, and it is not from fear.

lines.zh: 你砍到壳上，火星都出来了。
lines.en: You struck my shell and sparks came off.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，底下的肉露出来。
lines.en: The shell cracked and the flesh beneath is exposed.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，腿全收进去。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and pull in every leg.

lines.zh: 疼让我往回爬了两步。
lines.en: The pain made me crawl back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的甲很硬，可你的剑更硬。
lines.en: My shell is hard, but your blade is harder.

lines.zh: 裂口在渗水，我不去管。
lines.en: The crack seeps fluid and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 你劈断了我一条腿，我还有。
lines.en: You cut off one leg; I have others.

lines.zh: 壳上留了个印，我记住你的剑。
lines.en: A mark on my shell; I remember your blade.

lines.zh: 我疼得磨牙，石粉掉了一地。
lines.en: I grind my mouthparts in pain and dust falls.

lines.zh: 别以为裂了壳我就不能走。
lines.en: Do not think a cracked shell stops me walking.

lines.zh: 你手上有甲壳的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell chitin on your hands.

lines.zh: 那块甲片掉在地上，我盯着。
lines.en: That shell shard fell to the floor and I am fixed on it.

lines.zh: 我把触须伸出去，试探那味道。
lines.en: I stretch my feelers out to test that smell.

lines.zh: 深层里没什么吃的，甲壳例外。
lines.en: There is little to eat in the deep, chitin excepted.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的头就跟着转。
lines.en: You step back half a pace and my head follows.

lines.zh: 这东西敲起来像我的壳。
lines.en: This thing rings like my own shell.

lines.zh: 我先用爪碰一下，再咬。
lines.en: I touch it with a claw first, then bite.

lines.zh: 我饿得太久，连石头都想啃。
lines.en: I have been hungry so long I would gnaw stone.

lines.zh: 你把甲片收起来，我就不装了。
lines.en: You put the shard away, so I stop pretending.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙爬近，装作路过。
lines.en: I crawl along the wall, pretending to pass by.

lines.zh: 深层岩缝里，我的甲壳咔咔响。
lines.en: In the deep rock, my shell clicks.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，甲壳先到。
lines.en: I hit your leg shell first.

lines.zh: 这么硬的壳，撞一下也不疼。
lines.en: With a shell this hard, a bump does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你把我推开，我六条腿全钉住了。
lines.en: You shove me and all six legs dig in.

lines.zh: 我们撞出一片石粉。
lines.en: We collided and a cloud of stone dust rose.

lines.zh: 我退后，壳在石头上刮响。
lines.en: I back away, my shell scraping the stone.

lines.zh: 你别踩，我的腿会断。
lines.en: Do not step there; my leg will snap.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转了半圈才走开。
lines.en: I circle half around you before moving off.

lines.zh: 撞到洞壁，我掉了一小片甲。
lines.en: Hitting the cave wall, I shed a small flake of shell.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我的触须碰到你了。
lines.en: You are too close; my feelers touched you.

lines.zh: 我们在石缝里，用触须互相敲。
lines.en: In the crevice we tap each other with feelers.

lines.zh: 它的壳比我的薄，颜色更深。
lines.en: Its shell is thinner than mine and darker.

lines.zh: 我替它清掉壳上的碎石。
lines.en: I clear the rubble off its shell for it.

lines.zh: 我们把卵塞进最深的石缝。
lines.en: We push the eggs into the deepest crack.

lines.zh: 它爬过来时，腿声很轻。
lines.en: When it crawled over, its legs were very quiet.

lines.zh: 我们并排爬，甲壳一直碰。
lines.en: We crawl side by side, our shells knocking constantly.

lines.zh: 深层没有季节，我们照样成对。
lines.en: The deep has no seasons, yet we still pair up.

lines.zh: 它走之后，石缝里还有它的味。
lines.en: After it left, its smell stayed in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我用爪在石上划了道记号。
lines.en: I scratched a mark on the stone with my claw.

lines.zh: 同族的壳都会反一点点光。
lines.en: The shells of my kind all catch a little light.

lines.zh: 我把那块甲片塞进石缝。
lines.en: I wedge that shell shard into the crack.

lines.zh: 这东西挂着我的爪，甩不掉。
lines.en: This thing is caught on my claw and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 我叼着它爬了两步就放下。
lines.en: I carry it two steps in my mouth and drop it.

lines.zh: 你掉的矿石，我拖回洞底。
lines.en: I drag the ore you dropped back to the cave floor.

lines.zh: 我压在身下，谁也拿不到。
lines.en: I press it under my body; no one can take it.

lines.zh: 太亮了，我用石粉盖住。
lines.en: It is too bright, so I cover it with stone dust.

lines.zh: 我用触须碰了碰，是冷的。
lines.en: I touch it with a feeler; it is cold.

lines.zh: 它卡在壳缝里，正好带走。
lines.en: It stuck in my shell seam, so I take it along.

lines.zh: 我试着啃，牙差点崩了。
lines.en: I try to gnaw it and nearly crack a tooth.

lines.zh: 捡起来很轻，我有点失望。
lines.en: It is very light when lifted, which disappoints me.

lines.zh: 灯一晃，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: The lamp swayed and I knew where you were.

lines.zh: 你的脚步让洞底的石头跳。
lines.en: Your steps make the stones on the floor jump.

lines.zh: 深层的猎物不多，我不会放过。
lines.en: Prey is scarce in the deep; I will not let you go.

lines.zh: 我沿墙绕到你上方了。
lines.en: I have crawled along the wall to above you.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气在洞里是热的。
lines.en: The breath you exhale is warm in this cave.

lines.zh: 我把腿张开，压低身子。
lines.en: I spread my legs and sink my body low.

lines.zh: 石缝里的震动全是你的。
lines.en: All the vibration in the crack is yours.

lines.zh: 你挡住我了，那就从你身上过。
lines.en: You are in my way, so I will go over you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，比石头快。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, faster than stone.

lines.zh: 灯的影子定住了，你停下了。
lines.en: The lamp's shadow stopped, so you have stopped.

lines.zh: 我要的只是让你别再往前走。
lines.en: I only want you to stop moving forward.

lines.zh: 我选好了，就从洞顶下来。
lines.en: I have chosen; I will come down from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我在洞顶等你走进下面。
lines.en: I wait on the ceiling for you to walk beneath.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，石头都会告诉我。
lines.en: Wherever you go, the stone tells me.

lines.zh: 我的腿已经扣住了石面。
lines.en: My legs have already gripped the stone.

lines.zh: 你举灯照洞顶，我往旁边挪。
lines.en: You raise the lamp to the ceiling and I shift aside.

lines.zh: 三步之内，我落下去就够了。
lines.en: Within three steps, dropping down will suffice.

lines.zh: 你退到塌方口，那就没路了。
lines.en: You back to the cave-in, so there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我不动，是因为石头还没松。
lines.en: I stay still because the stone has not loosened.

lines.zh: 你的灯晃得厉害，你在犹豫。
lines.en: Your lamp wavers badly; you are hesitating.

lines.zh: 我把前腿抬起来，又放下。
lines.en: I lift my front legs, then set them down.

lines.zh: 这一片洞顶，我爬过十几次。
lines.en: I have crossed this ceiling a dozen times.

lines.zh: 我算好了落点，就在你脚跟后。
lines.en: I have my landing spot, just behind your heel.

lines.zh: 你在听，可你听不见甲壳的声音。
lines.en: You are listening, but you cannot hear my shell.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下，正好砸你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 前腿扣住你，我就开始咬。
lines.en: My front legs lock on and I start biting.

lines.zh: 这一下七点，你的护甲挡不住第二次。
lines.en: Seven points now; your armor will not take a second.

lines.zh: 我咬你的手腕，让你放下灯。
lines.en: I bite your wrist so you drop the lamp.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞上你的肋骨，很闷的一声。
lines.en: My shell hits your ribs with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你挥过来，我缩进壳里。
lines.en: You swing and I pull back into my shell.

lines.zh: 我抓你的脚踝，往石头上拖。
lines.en: I grip your ankle and drag it toward the stone.

lines.zh: 腿缠住你的小腿，我咬下去。
lines.en: My legs wrap your shin and I bite down.

lines.zh: 你踩我的背，我只滑了一下。
lines.en: You stomp my back and I only slide a little.

lines.zh: 我咬完就爬回石缝里。
lines.en: After biting, I crawl back into the crack.

lines.zh: 我从洞底的碎石里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawled out from the rubble on the cave floor.

lines.zh: 石头裂了一道缝，我就出来了。
lines.en: A crack opened in the stone, and I came out.

lines.zh: 深层一直很暗，我习惯了。
lines.en: The deep is always dark, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我的第一层壳是软的。
lines.en: My first shell was soft.

lines.zh: 这片洞壁我还没爬过。
lines.en: I have not yet crawled this cave wall.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的石屑，腿才长齐。
lines.en: I shook off the grit, and only then did my legs finish.

lines.zh: 洞里没有人，只有水声。
lines.en: There is no one in the cave, only dripping water.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里等了很久才动。
lines.en: I waited a long time in the crack before moving.

lines.zh: 第一顿饭是石头上的苔。
lines.en: My first meal was the moss on the stone.

lines.zh: 我出生时壳还没硬，走不快。
lines.en: I was born with a soft shell and could not walk fast.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，石头味都变了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my shell and the stone smell changes.

lines.zh: 从洞顶摔下来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Falling from the ceiling, I flipped over once.

lines.zh: 深层的水很冷，灌进壳缝里。
lines.en: The deep's water is cold and pours into my shell.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到洞壁上。
lines.en: The blast threw me against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 那根细东西卡在我的甲缝里。
lines.en: That thin thing lodged in the seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 这股味道让我的腿发软。
lines.en: This smell makes my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 洞里没有苔，我啃起了石头。
lines.en: There is no moss in the cave, so I gnaw stone.

lines.zh: 电顺着石壁流下来，打中了我。
lines.en: The current ran down the wall and struck me.

lines.zh: 深层里没有石壁可抓。
lines.en: No stone to grip in this void.
